The full expression describing all points on our hyperbolic cylinder is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{(y+1)^{2}}{4}=1,\,z=k
$$

where $k\in R$ can vary arbitrarily. 

The domain of any cylinder in the $xy$-plane is its base curve. Hence, in this case, the domain is

$$
\{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}:\text{ }\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{(y+1)^{2}}{4}=1\}.
$$

This is a hyperbola centered at $(0,-1).$
